description: Header file defining the ActivityManager class and related enums for Android's activity management, including process states and UID observer flags.

classes.name: ActivityManager
classes.description: Class providing methods to interact with Android's activity and UID observer system, including process states and UID observer registration.

methods.name: registerUidObserver
methods.description: Registers a UID observer with specific event flags.

methods.name: registerUidObserverForUids
methods.description: Registers a UID observer for specific UIDs.

methods.name: addUidToObserver
methods.description: Adds a UID to an existing observer.

methods.name: removeUidFromObserver
methods.description: Removes a UID from an observer.

methods.name: isUidActive
methods.description: Checks if a UID is active.

methods.name: getUidProcessState
methods.description: Retrieves the process state of a UID.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks a permission for a given PID and UID.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Links a death recipient to the service.

methods.name: unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unlinks a death recipient from the service.
